failures.symptom: Guessed template path missing; current operation pages unavailable in web retrieval.
failures.cause: Template filename inferred without inventory; web tool returned inaccessible pages and search results with different resource/release identities.
failures.correction: Use actual template inventory and retain version-scoped local contracts; fresh target-release/API readiness remains a future implementation gate.

prevention.rule: Inspect actual shapes and prerequisites; Gate 0 current-product-sensitive assumptions and source identity
prevention.reason: No product repair: exact local template presence checked and source/release limitation documented. No failed live business operation occurred. Original reads were unmeasured, preserved as a timing/evidence gap.

verification.command: Local inventory, selected source existence/hash review and scope reconciliation
verification.reviewer: Codex root checked exact paths and preserved version limits
